scenarios.name: Open and exit the free-rotation mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software
the viewport navigation bar is visible
the user selects the orbit control on the navigation bar
the status area indicates free rotation
the active part remains visible
the user moves through the viewport using a drag gesture
a circular guide with a central cross and radial marks is visible over the viewport
the user opens the context menu in the viewport
it offers Done, OK, Home View, Pan, Zoom and Previous View
the user chooses Done
the circular guide disappears
the status area displays Ready
the same part remains active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software
the user opens the orbit menu on the navigation bar
the menu offers Orbit, Constrained Orbit and Rotate at Angle
the user chooses Constrained Orbit
a circular rotation guide appears over the viewport
the active part remains visible
the user presses Escape
the guide disappears
the status area displays Ready
the user reopens the orbit menu
Constrained Orbit is marked as the selected action

scenarios.name: Preview and reset an incremental view rotation

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a rectangular face oriented toward the viewer in the active part in the MCAD Software
the user chooses Rotate at Angle from the orbit menu
an incremental view rotation dialog opens
it contains an increment field, six direction buttons, Reset, OK and Cancel
the increment field displays 10
the user clicks the first direction button
the visible view changes while the dialog remains open
the user clicks Reset
the original face-on view is restored
the user clicks the first direction button again
the user clicks Cancel
the dialog closes
the original face-on view is restored
the status area displays Ready
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a rectangular face oriented toward the viewer in the active part in the MCAD Software
the user chooses Rotate at Angle from the orbit menu
the increment field displays 10
the user clicks the first direction button
the visible view changes while the dialog remains open
the user clicks OK
the dialog closes
the changed view remains visible
the same part remains active
the status area displays Ready

scenarios.name: Reverse an incremental rotation with the adjacent control

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid at an inclined orientation in the MCAD Software
the incremental view rotation dialog is open with increment 10
the user clicks the second direction button
the block view changes
the user clicks the first direction button once
the block returns to its initial apparent orientation
the dialog remains open
the user clicks Cancel
the dialog closes and the status area displays Ready
